description: Android activity class for configuring Google Fit integration in a Wear OS watch face, managing user authorization, connection to Google Fit APIs, and preferences.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: Android activity for configuring Google Fit access and preferences for a Wear OS watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, restores state, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if Google Fit is enabled.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from authorization activity, updates preferences accordingly.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles connection failure, attempts resolution if possible.

methods.name: onSwitchClicked
methods.description: Handles user toggling Google Fit authorization switch, initiates connect/disconnect.

methods.name: setUserFitPreferences
methods.description: Updates user preferences for Google Fit and updates UI switch state.
